scripts.test: bun run test:frontend && bun run test:rust && bun run test:startup-packaging
scripts.test:reliability: node --test scripts/reliability-gate.test.mjs scripts/reliability-source-guard.test.mjs scripts/prepare-update-channel.test.mjs scripts/build-identity.test.mjs scripts/install-clipper-host.test.mjs scripts/install-cli.test.mjs scripts/clipper-runtime-manifest.test.mjs scripts/verify-extension-mirrors.test.mjs scripts/finalize-local-bundle.test.mjs
scripts.test:reliability-updates: vitest run extension/lib/draftStore.test.ts extension/popup/lib/protocol.test.ts extension/popup/lib/saveOperation.test.ts extension/popup/hooks/useClipperState.standalone.test.tsx extension/background.connection.test.ts extension/background.messaging.test.ts extension/lib/standaloneVault.test.ts extension/lib/standaloneVault.recovery.test.ts

scripts.bindings:generate: bun run fetch:ytdlp && cargo run -p mine --bin export-bindings --features tooling --locked

scripts.verify:core: bun run verify:reliability && bun run test:save-core && bun run bindings:check && bun run lint && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.verify: bun run verify:core && bun run test:browser
scripts.verify:release: bun run verify:reliability-release && bun run verify && bun run test:clipper-worker && bun run test:native-shell
scripts.build:local-app: bunx tauri build --bundles app && bun run finalize:local-app
